title: Origin Bancorp, Inc. to Transfer Stock Exchange Listing to Texas Stock Exchange
summary: Ticker symbol to remain "OBK"RUSTON, La., Sept. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Origin Bancorp, Inc. (NYSE: OBK) ("Origin"), the holding company for Origin Bank, announced today that it will transfer its stock exchange listing from the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) to the Texas Stock Exchange (“TXSE”).
